sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the Appellant instead of pressing this application for suspension of further execution of sentence and grant of bail to the Appellants pending disposal of this Appeal, confines his submission for grant of interim bail to the Appellant No.2.

He submits that the Appellant No.2 being arrested in the case is in custody for about 6 years and for such long detention of the Appellant No.2 in custody, it is not only that he is suffering but also his family members are now suffering a lot.

He submits that the family members of the Appellant No.2 having somehow been able to manage the situation till now, henceforth to continue, they need the help of this Appellant No.2 and for that reason, the presence of this Appellant No.2 at home for sometime is absolutely necessary.
He, therefore, prays for disposal of this application accepting the prayer as aforesaid.
3. Learned counsel for the Respondent-State does not dispute the period of the detention of the Appellant No.2 during trial and thereafter.

4. Considering the submissions made and on going through the judgment of conviction as also the deposition of the victim and other witnesses, while being not inclined to grant bail to the Appellant No.2, pending disposal of this Appeal, taking into account the long period of detention of the Appellant No.2 in custody and his need at present be there at home for sometime to look after their family members; it is directed that the Appellant No.2 be released on interim bail for a period of 03 (three) months from the date of his actual release from the custody by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Jagatsinghpur in Special G.R. No.15 of 2015 on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper with further conditions that the he will positively surrender before the learned court in seissin of the case on the date as would be so directed.
5. The Misc. Case is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
List this Appeal for hearing in the week commencing 9th September, 2024.
